I Just Want To Make Love To You

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **I Just Want To Make Love To You** (2 reviews, 1 other source): Jerry's playing is on fire in the pre-drums I Just Want To Make Love To You; deserved more outings; The goofy-sounding I Just Want To Make Love To You was said to be its second and last performance [4][21][24]
- **Candyman** (2 reviews): During Candyman, Jerry looked the reviewer in the eye and started playing hot, ripping leads; Candyman was singled out as unbelievable [20][26]
- **Aiko Aiko** (1 review): Opening with Aiko Aiko got the room rocking [26]
- **Lazy Lightning** (1 review): Suggests Lazy Lightning was retired because this version was so good it couldn't be surpassed, despite a later BCT one [30]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Terrapin plus three short songs fill 47 minutes, with about half of it pure jamming [23]
- **Iko Iko** (1 review): The drums at the start of Iko startled and confused the reviewer [22]

## Setlist highlights

- **Bird Song**: cut on the recording [32]
- **I Just Want To Make Love To You**: rare: 4 archived performances [32]

## The recordings

- **gd1984-10-08.132550.Nak100CP4.Hill.Keo.Flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 151 min [1]. Said about its sound: There are tape pauses between first-set songs [1]
- **gd1984-10-08.nak100.holtz-bolton.GEMS.97535.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 153 min; rated 3.25/5 by 4 [4]
- **gd1984-10-08.167998.beyer.m160.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 19 songs; 154 min [5]
- **gd84-10-08.rice-naks.willy.7773.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 19 songs; 153 min; rated 3.25/5 by 4 [8]
- **gd1984-10-08.senn421.pauline.miller.91376.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 143 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [15]. Said about its sound: The set two disc change is seamless [15]

## Around the show

- About ten friends drove from Boston, sat second row before Jerry, and blew opium smoke toward him [20]
- Reviewer's first show; the Centrum looked packed, and the seats put the crowd's tiny figures close [22]
- Floor was rowdy and wild; the Centrum was a year old and Worcester police couldn't handle roughly 12,000 fans [26]
- Reviewer attended this as their eighth show, and the following night was their first trip there [29]
- Reviewer says the Lazy Lightning/Supplication pairing returned on 10/31 in Berkeley, then was dropped for good [20]
- Opening a second set with Terrapin hadn't happened in ages [23]
- The first half of set two is as far out as they went since 1974 [23]
- This night was weaker than the following night's second set, at least its first half [24]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1984-10-08.132550.Nak100CP4.Hill.Keo.Flac1644**: taped by Steve Hill; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Steve Hill, Transfer By Keo; Nakamichi CM100/CP4 Shotguns > Sony D5, Tapes:Maxell UDXLII 90's; Tapes Labelled:Nakamichi 100 Guns -… [1]
- **gd1984-10-08.nak100.holtz-bolton.GEMS.97535.flac16**: taped by Greg Holtz and Tony Bolton; transferred by Alex Ford and Jamie Waddell; source: Master Cassette FOB right side about 8 feet in front of the SBD(Jerry's side - about 10 feet right of center - 2 Nak 100's w/CP-4 shotgun caps > Sony D-5 [4]. Also: Nakamichi 100 recording by Holtz and Bolton, issued through GEMS [4]
- **gd1984-10-08.167998.beyer.m160.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Jim Vita's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Beyer M160 mics > Sony D5M (Maxell XLII-S) [5]. Also: A Nakamichi 700 source from Steve Rolfe supplies an 8:09 patch in Drums [5]
- **gd84-10-08.rice-naks.willy.7773.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Mike Rice; source: Nak CM 100 mics w/ shotgun capsules > Sony D5 cassette deck [8]. Also: Greg Holtz and Tony Bolton ran Mike Rice's D-5 and D-6 decks with Nakamichi CM-100 and CP-4 capsules, beside the soundboard [24]
- **gd1984-10-08.senn421.pauline.miller.91376.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Sennheiser 421 -> Cassette Master (Sony D5/Maxell XLII-S90) D [15]. Also: Beyer M88 front-of-board cassette master; no audience patch for Drums was found, and the soundboard wasn't used [15]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Steve Schneider Grateful Dead: [1984-10-08 The Centrum, Worcester, MA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1984-10-08-the-centrum-worcester-ma-usa/) [36]
- Poster by Steve Schneider Grateful Dead: [1984-10-09 The Centrum, Worcester, MA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1984-10-09-the-centrum-worcester-ma-usa/) [37]

Reviewer's first show; the Centrum looked packed, and the seats put the crowd's tiny figures close
The drums at the start of Iko startled and confused the reviewer
Terrapin plus three short songs fill 47 minutes, with about half of it pure jamming
Opening a second set with Terrapin hadn't happened in ages
The first half of set two is as far out as they went since 1974
Greg Holtz and Tony Bolton ran Mike Rice's D-5 and D-6 decks with Nakamichi CM-100 and CP-4 capsules, beside the soundboard

claims.song: I Just Want To Make Love To You
claims.text: The goofy-sounding I Just Want To Make Love To You was said to be its second and last performance
This night was weaker than the following night's second set, at least its first half
Floor was rowdy and wild; the Centrum was a year old and Worcester police couldn't handle roughly 12,000 fans
Opening with Aiko Aiko got the room rocking
Candyman was singled out as unbelievable
Says I Just Want To Make Love To You was last played on 2-21-95, and was also done in 1966
Preferred the second night; this show seemed uninspired after the Aiko opener and never really took off
Found the next night tighter and more on top of things than this sloppy, gritty, spacy show
Reviewer attended this as their eighth show, and the following night was their first trip there
Suggests Lazy Lightning was retired because this version was so good it couldn't be surpassed, despite a later BCT one
Nakamichi 100 with CP4 capsules source from the Hill collection, recorded and shared by Steve
There are tape pauses between first-set songs
Nakamichi 100 recording by Holtz and Bolton, issued through GEMS

claims.song: I Just Want To Make Love To You
claims.text: Notes label this I Just Want To Make Love To You as the final one
Master cassettes came from Jim Vita, with a Beyer M160 source transferred by Charlie Miller
A Nakamichi 700 source from Steve Rolfe supplies an 8:09 patch in Drums
Beyer M88 front-of-board cassette master; no audience patch for Drums was found, and the soundboard wasn't used
The set two disc change is seamless
